# Membership requirements

## Registration

### LIB-001 Member registration
A visitor shall register with a valid email address and a password to become a member.

### LIB-002 Registration confirmation email
The system must send a confirmation email after registration.

## Borrowing limits

### LIB-003 Concurrent borrow limit
A member may borrow at most 5 books at the same time.

### LIB-004 Return period
Borrowed books must be returned within 14 days.
